ballots.name: Ines
ballots.reason: Logged, read-only access does not prevent private scratch notes from being misinterpreted or preserve trust in working memory, especially when exclusion from a meeting permits access.

ballots.name: Omar
ballots.reason: Read-only, logged access during genuine absence gets the meeting the facts it needs without write risk, and the "not invited" trigger deserves tightening but doesn't justify deciding blind in the common mid-command case.

ballots.name: Priya
ballots.reason: The motion as written logs access but does not require the chair to cite which notes informed a decision, leaving selective use and cherry-picking unauditable, which means I cannot hold anyone accountable for how accessed information shaped outcomes.
